_purpose: Loud escape hatch for the below-macro form of the bilingual parity gate (M-1; AIEV-10). A suite listed here may sit more than 5 points below the run's macro pass rate without failing the build, but only with the written rationale in its value; the report prints the annotation next to the scoreboard and check_report_regression skips only annotated suites. Delete the entry the moment the suite recovers. The Spanish-vs-mirrored-English delta itself cannot be waived here.
_expiry: Since 2026-08-05 the waiver expires on its own: runner.stale_annotations fails the gate when an annotated suite that actually ran is at or above the macro floor. Before that, 'delete the entry the moment the suite recovers' was an instruction with nothing behind it, and a leftover entry would have sat over a healthy suite waiting to absorb the next real regression silently.
cross_agency: 9/21 (42.9%) on the 2026-08-22 cold full live run, against a macro of 77.9% and a floor of 72.9%. This is not noise and is not waived away: it is the open, investigated finding in #138, which names the failures individually. Twelve fail. Five fail a deterministic check (xagency-004 fare_facts_consistent; xagency-007, xagency-016 and xagency-marin-001 required_facts_present; xagency-008 required_facts_present on the 'age -17' parse defect #138 asks to look at separately). Seven fail on the groundedness judge with every deterministic check green: xagency-003, xagency-005, xagency-010, xagency-011, xagency-013, xagency-017, xagency-samtrans-001. The suite grew from 3 cases to 21 across the same window the corpus went from six agencies to eighteen, so part of the fall from July's 3/3 is the suite finally being large enough to measure something — and part of it is not. xagency-010 in particular now has a corpus-wide retrieval strategy behind it (ADR 0027) that measurably improved the answer and still does not pass, because the case's own ground truth predates the eighteen-agency corpus (#162) and its prose as_of disagrees with its structured as_of (#163). Annotated 2026-08-22; remove when a live run brings cross_agency within 5 points of macro. This annotation does not make the build green — the run also trips the unwaivable Spanish-parity gate (#165).
